name: Cu/Au Ratio ROC Quartiles vs SPY Forward Returns
description: Tests whether extreme momentum in the copper/gold ratio predicts S&P 500 returns. Computes 20-day ROC of HG/GC ratio, ranks it via rolling 1-year percentile into quartiles (Q1=most falling, Q4=most rising). Measures 63-day (~3 month) forward SPY returns per quartile. Exhibits: median return bars by quartile, boxplot of return distributions, and stats table with N/median/hit rate/best/worst per quartile.
source:
# Cu/Au Ratio ROC Quartiles vs SPY Forward Returns
# Thesis: Extreme rising Cu/Au momentum (Q4) → stronger SPY returns
#         Extreme falling Cu/Au momentum (Q1) → weaker SPY returns
# Signal: 20d ROC of HG/GC ratio → percentrank(252) → quartile buckets

# --- Data ---
ts = index()()
src = market_data_source()()
spy_close = src.c

# Load copper (HG) and gold (GC) — NoAdjustment for cross-commodity ratio
hg_raw = reference_futures(ticker='HG')()
hg = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment)(hg_raw.o, hg_raw.h, hg_raw.l, hg_raw.c, hg_raw.v, hg_raw.oi, hg_raw.s)

gc_raw = reference_futures(ticker='GC')()
gc = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment)(gc_raw.o, gc_raw.h, gc_raw.l, gc_raw.c, gc_raw.v, gc_raw.oi, gc_raw.s)

# ffill reference data to align with SPY calendar
hg_close = ffill(hg.c)
gc_close = ffill(gc.c)

# --- Copper/Gold Ratio & 20d ROC ---
ratio = hg_close / gc_close
ratio_roc = roc(period=20)(ratio)

# --- Quartile Buckets via Rolling 1Y Percentile Rank ---
# percentrank(252) → 0-100 scale vs trailing 1 year
roc_pctrank = percentrank(period=252)(ratio_roc)

# Quartile assignment: Q1 (0-25) = most falling, Q4 (75-100) = most rising
# NaN-guard: percentrank warmup produces NaN for first 252 bars
quartile = conditional_select(
    is_valid(roc_pctrank) and roc_pctrank <= 25, 1.0,
    is_valid(roc_pctrank) and roc_pctrank <= 50, 2.0,
    is_valid(roc_pctrank) and roc_pctrank <= 75, 3.0,
    is_valid(roc_pctrank) and roc_pctrank <= 100, 4.0,
    0.0 / 0.0
)

# --- SPY Forward Returns (63 trading days ≈ 3 months) ---
spy_fwd_63d = forward_returns(period=63)(spy_close)

# Quartile-filtered forward returns
q1_fwd = where(quartile == 1.0, spy_fwd_63d)
q2_fwd = where(quartile == 2.0, spy_fwd_63d)
q3_fwd = where(quartile == 3.0, spy_fwd_63d)
q4_fwd = where(quartile == 4.0, spy_fwd_63d)

# Hit rate helpers (% positive forward returns per quartile)
q1_hit = where(quartile == 1.0, 1.0 if (is_valid(spy_fwd_63d) and spy_fwd_63d > 0) else 0.0)
q2_hit = where(quartile == 2.0, 1.0 if (is_valid(spy_fwd_63d) and spy_fwd_63d > 0) else 0.0)
q3_hit = where(quartile == 3.0, 1.0 if (is_valid(spy_fwd_63d) and spy_fwd_63d > 0) else 0.0)
q4_hit = where(quartile == 4.0, 1.0 if (is_valid(spy_fwd_63d) and spy_fwd_63d > 0) else 0.0)

# --- Event Markers: Entering Extreme Quartiles ---
enter_q4 = crossover(roc_pctrank, 75.0)
enter_q1 = crossunder(roc_pctrank, 25.0)
is_extreme_entry = enter_q4 or enter_q1

extreme_label = "Q4: Extreme Rising" if enter_q4 else "Q1: Extreme Falling"
extreme_roc_val = where(is_extreme_entry, ratio_roc)
extreme_spy = where(is_extreme_entry, spy_close)
extreme_pctrank = where(is_extreme_entry, roc_pctrank)

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Cu/Au ROC Extreme Entry',
        icon=Icon.ActivityIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Quartile', type=CardRenderType.TextFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(title='20d ROC', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='Percentile Rank', dp=0, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='SPY Price', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(extreme_label, extreme_roc_val, extreme_pctrank, extreme_spy, is_extreme_entry)

# --- Chart 1: Median 3M SPY Return by ROC Quartile (Punchline) ---
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.series,
    agg=AggregationType.Median,
    title='Does Cu/Au Momentum Predict SPY? Median 3M Return by Quartile',
    category='Cu/Au ROC Quartiles',
    x_axis_label='',
    y_axis_label='Median 3M Forward Return',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Q1 (Most Falling)', color=Color.Red),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Q2', color=Color.Slate),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Q3', color=Color.Slate),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Q4 (Most Rising)', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    order=1
)(values=(q1_fwd, q2_fwd, q3_fwd, q4_fwd))

# --- Chart 2: Boxplot of 3M Returns by Quartile (Distribution) ---
# Quartile label for grouping
quartile_label = conditional_select(
    quartile == 1.0, 'Q1 (Most Falling)',
    quartile == 2.0, 'Q2',
    quartile == 3.0, 'Q3',
    quartile == 4.0, 'Q4 (Most Rising)',
    'N/A'
)

boxplot(
    mode=BoxplotMode.grouped,
    title='Can You Trust the Quartile Spread? 3M Return Distributions',
    category='Cu/Au ROC Quartiles',
    x_axis_label='Cu/Au ROC Quartile',
    y_axis_label='3M Forward SPY Return',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    fill_color=Color.Blue,
    median_color=Color.White,
    whisker_color=Color.Slate,
    stem_color=Color.Slate,
    outlier_color=Color.Gray,
    outlier_line_color=Color.Gray,
    order=2
)(label=quartile_label, values=(spy_fwd_63d,))

# --- Table: Quartile Stats (Reference) ---
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category='Cu/Au ROC Quartiles',
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Quartile Stats: N, Median, Hit Rate, Best & Worst',
        row_size=5, col_size=4,
        row_headers=['N (Days)', 'Median 3M Ret', 'Hit Rate (% Pos)', 'Best 3M Ret', 'Worst 3M Ret'],
        col_headers=['Q1 (Most Falling)', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4 (Most Rising)'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    ),
    order=3
)(q1_fwd, q2_fwd, q3_fwd, q4_fwd, q1_fwd, q2_fwd, q3_fwd, q4_fwd, q1_hit, q2_hit, q3_hit, q4_hit, q1_fwd, q2_fwd, q3_fwd, q4_fwd, q1_fwd, q2_fwd, q3_fwd, q4_fwd)
